components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single affirmative action on a surface; solid brand green.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)) 85%, #1a2b33); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered neutral action; hover fills one surface step up.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered field; focus shifts border and a hugging 1px ring to primary.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Compact nav row; the active state is a 10%-alpha green pill (in the app, one absolutely-positioned pill travels between rows).
components.html: FilesSyncActivity
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 200px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-secondary, oklch(0.4501 0.0191 239.4931)); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-bg-secondary, oklch(0.9396 0.0204 243.4220)); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: 24x44 pill switch; green track when on, hairline track when off.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-border, oklch(0.8999 0.0196 240.7516)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-toggle--on { background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); } .ds-toggle-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-toggle--on .ds-toggle-thumb { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); }

components.name: Sync Status Chip
components.description: TitleBar micro pill whose tint is the status code: green idle, blue syncing, red paused.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip--idle { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)); } .ds-chip--idle:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.6236 0.1833 147.4139)) 20%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: The desktop app is an Operate-mode work tool: a file manager, sync monitor, and viewer that people keep open all day. It is designed to read as part of the operating system rather than as a website in a frame - system font stack, a custom 52px title bar with a real drag region, overlay scrollbars, user-select: none chrome, and a window body that never scrolls. Visual energy is deliberately low: quiet blue-grey neutral surfaces carry dense information, and a single green accent marks the active and the affirmative. The theme system is a deliberate mirror of the web app: eight selectable themes x light/dark/system defined as [data-theme] blocks whose values are copied verbatim from apps/web/src/index.css; the desktop consumes them through a seven-token subset aliased onto --color-* names, with derived shades computed via color-mix().
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, dense, utilitarian; information first, decoration nowhere
One green accent (oklch 0.62/0.18/147 light, 0.70/0.18/149 dark - the #22c55e family) on cool blue-grey neutrals
Native desktop feel: system fonts, custom TitleBar, 6px overlay scrollbars, no text selection in chrome
Theme-proof components: everything routes through var(--color-*) aliases so all 8 themes and both modes work untouched
Flat surfaces separated by 1px hairline borders; shadows reserved for overlays
Full prefers-reduced-motion kill switch on all animation and transitions

rules.name: The Alias-Only Rule
rules.body: Components never touch --background/--primary directly and never hardcode a theme color; they consume only the --color-* aliases (or Tailwind [var(--color-*)] arbitrary values). This is what makes all 8 themes x 2 modes work without per-component changes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent voice in chrome. When a second hue appears it is a status code (blue = in flight, amber = degraded, red = failed/destructive), never decoration.

rules.name: The Fixed Islands Exception
rules.body: Four surfaces intentionally ignore the theme: the plain-text/code viewer (fixed charcoal #1e1e1e/#d4d4d4 in both modes), MapLibre photo pins (fixed light neutrals with white frames), the per-filetype icon set and provider logos (own brand colors), and the in-file find highlight (fixed amber for visibility against any theme).

rules.name: The Fourteen-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Body text is text-sm (14px). text-base (16px) is effectively absent from the app - new UI copy defaults to 14px, labels to 12px.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't float (modal, menu, flyout, pin), it doesn't cast a shadow. In-flow cards and panels are flat with hairline borders.

dos: Do route every color through the --color-* aliases (Tailwind form: text-[var(--color-text-muted)], bg-[var(--color-bg-secondary)]). If a new shade is needed, derive it with color-mix() from existing tokens.
Do keep green singular: --color-primary marks the active nav item, the affirmative button, the on-state - and nothing decorative.
Do default new text to 14px (text-sm), metadata to 12px (text-xs), and use the documented micro steps (8-11px) only inside dense chrome.
Do use the standard focus treatment (primary border + 1px primary ring) on any new focusable control.
Do keep new surfaces flat with 1px hairline borders; reserve shadow-lg/shadow-xl for things that genuinely float.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on any new animation.
Do add accent-[var(--color-primary)] to native checkboxes/radios/ranges - the list-view checkboxes that lack it are a known gap, not a pattern to copy.
donts: Don't hardcode theme-dependent hexes in components - a color that must survive all 8 themes is either a --color-* alias or belongs to the documented Fixed Islands (viewer charcoal, map pin neutrals, file-icon set, provider brand marks, find-highlight amber, workspace accent set).
Don't import rules from the repo-root DESIGN.md - that file documents the marketing site. This file governs apps/desktop.
Don't add a second accent hue, gradients, or decorative color to chrome; blue/amber/red are status codes only.
Don't introduce webfonts; the system stack is the identity.
Don't put shadows on in-flow cards or grow radii past 12px for containers (16px is reserved for the pin frame and hero tiles).

Don't edit theme token values in styles/index.css unilaterally - they mirror apps/web/src/index.css and apps/web/src/lib/themes.ts (and the API allow-list in apps/api/src/lib/appearance.ts); parity is the contract.
